summary: Gladstone Land Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a preferred stock repurchase program authorized by its Board on July 15, 2026. The program allows repurchases of up to $20M of Series B Preferred and $35M of Series C Preferred, for a total of $55M. The authorization expires July 14, 2027, with no obligation to acquire any specific amount. Repurchases may be made in open market or private transactions, subject to securities laws and trading windows, potentially under Rule 10b5-1 plans. Prices and timing depend on market conditions. This is a capital-return event via preferred share buybacks, signaling potential undervaluation or surplus capital allocation.
